test.summary: SPM - OKR - Creating Number type custom field
test.description:
Test verifies creation of a Number type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Creating a Number type custom field with valid data
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the custom field value can be set during OKR creation
* Verifying that the value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views
* Verifying that the custom field is available only for Strategic Theme and Objective according to "Used in" configuration
* Verifying that the custom field is not visible for Key Result in any view

steps.action: Navigate to OKR settings → Fields of boxName
steps.data: boxName: TC-6118 SPM - OKR - Creating Number type custom field

steps.action: Type field name and description, select Number field type, select only "Objective / Strategic Theme" in the "Used in" section. Click Create button
steps.data:
* fieldName: Number field
* description: new created field
steps.result:
Number field is successfully created. New field appears in the "Your custom fields" list.
Field name, type, description and "Used in" values are displayed correctly

steps.action: Open Overview → click Add → Create strategic theme
steps.result: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"

steps.action: Enter strategic theme name, set period and Enter value in custom Number field. Click Create
steps.data:
* stName: Strategic theme 1
* period: Y2026
* Number field value: 123
steps.result: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view. Custom Number field is visible in the right-side with correct value.

steps.action: Click Add + button next to strategic theme and add objective
steps.result: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"

steps.action: Enter objective name, set period and enter value in custom Number field. Click Create
steps.data:
* objectiveName: Objective 1
* period: Y2026
* number field value: 123.45
steps.result: Objective is created and visible in tree view. Custom Number field is visible in the right-side with correct value.

steps.action: Click Add + button next to Objective and add Key result
steps.result: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field Number is not visible in the OKR creation modal

steps.action: Type name and Period and click Create
steps.result: Key-result is created and visible in tree view. Custom Number field is not visible in the right-side with correct value.

steps.action: Open Overview and navigate to Number field
steps.result: Number field is visible in the Overview table for Strategic Theme and Objective  with correct name and values. Value is empty and field is not editable for Key Result

steps.action: Click on the grey area of the Strategic theme row
steps.result: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Strategic theme. Number field is visible with correct name and value.

steps.action: Click on the grey area of the Objective row
steps.result: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. Number field is visible with correct name and value.

steps.action: Click on the grey area of the Key-result row
steps.result: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key-result. Number field is not visible

steps.action: Open Strategic theme in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
steps.result: Detail page is opened. Number field is visible with correct name and value.

steps.action: Open Objective in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
steps.result: Detail page is opened. Number field is visible with correct name and value.

steps.action: Open Key-result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
steps.result: Detail page is opened. Number field is not visible

rag.text:
Test: TC-6118 — SPM - OKR - Creating Number type custom field
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
Test verifies creation of a Number type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Creating a Number type custom field with valid data
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the custom field value can be set during OKR creation
* Verifying that the value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views
* Verifying that the custom field is available only for Strategic Theme and Objective according to "Used in" configuration
* Verifying that the custom field is not visible for Key Result in any view

Steps:
1. Navigate to OKR settings → Fields of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6118 SPM - OKR - Creating Number type custom field
   Expected: Fields settings page is displayed.
2. Click on "Create new" button.
   Expected: "Create custom field" modal is displayed.
3. Type field name and description, select Number field type, select only "Objective / Strategic Theme" in the "Used in" section. Click Create button
   Data: * fieldName: Number field
* description: new created field
   Expected: Number field is successfully created. New field appears in the "Your custom fields" list.
Field name, type, description and "Used in" values are displayed correctly
4. Open Overview → click Add → Create strategic theme
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"
5. Enter strategic theme name, set period and Enter value in custom Number field. Click Create
   Data: * stName: Strategic theme 1
* period: Y2026
* Number field value: 123
   Expected: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view. Custom Number field is visible in the right-side with correct value.
6. Click Add + button next to strategic theme and add objective
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"
7. Enter objective name, set period and enter value in custom Number field. Click Create
   Data: * objectiveName: Objective 1
* period: Y2026
* number field value: 123.45
   Expected: Objective is created and visible in tree view. Custom Number field is visible in the right-side with correct value.
8. Click Add + button next to Objective and add Key result
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field Number is not visible in the OKR creation modal
9. Type name and Period and click Create
   Data: * key-resultName: KR 1
* period: Y2026
   Expected: Key-result is created and visible in tree view. Custom Number field is not visible in the right-side with correct value.
10. Open Overview and navigate to Number field
   Expected: Number field is visible in the Overview table for Strategic Theme and Objective  with correct name and values. Value is empty and field is not editable for Key Result
11. Click on the grey area of the Strategic theme row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Strategic theme. Number field is visible with correct name and value.
12. Click on the grey area of the Objective row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. Number field is visible with correct name and value.
13. Click on the grey area of the Key-result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key-result. Number field is not visible
14. Open Strategic theme in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Number field is visible with correct name and value.
15. Open Objective in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Number field is visible with correct name and value.
16. Open Key-result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Number field is not visible
